saw_lines: Hiking boots are bought once and worn for years, so buyers trust the boot that already proved itself outdoors.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a hiker decides to trust the boot or scroll past it.
Your 11 of 20 ads open on the same Manche Produkte line, so test two or three new angles from the Alaska 30Y build against it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 3 Nov 2026
points: 11 of 20 copy ads open on the same “Manche Produkte” line, so buyers who scroll past it never see the boot. Test two or three new angles from the Alaska 30Y build, like the 1 000 pair run, against it.
One copy block runs in 11 of 20 ads, so a buyer sees the same story whichever ad they land on. Keep the copy, but change the opening line and photo in three new variations.

0 of 20 ads carry a proof number, so buyers have nothing concrete to trust before they click. Collect one real figure, such as a review count or orders shipped, and lead the next batch with it on the creative.
Creator posts run as brand ads

2 of 20 ads are creator posts run from the brand page, so a personal recommendation reads like a brand ad. Whitelist them from the creator account, then cut three variations so the personal voice runs in paid placements.

ads_1: Limited 1 000 pair Alaska 30Y run, tested against the current opener
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
